atender: to attend to, to deal with
auxiliará: will help, will come to the aid of
parte: part; side (por otra parte: on the other hand)
pupilo: ward, minor under guardianship (a pupilo: in tutelage)
capilla: (en capilla) on the eve, awaiting the event
celemín: a dry measure; (un celemín de recuerdos) a bushel of regards
concepto: opinion; (en el concepto de) with the idea of
corte: (dar un corte) to cut the matter short
echar: to throw; (echar mano) to lay hands on
entender: to understand; (dar a entender) to intimate
fines: ends; (a fines de) at the end of
grande: great; (en grande) on a large scale
inteligencia: understanding; (en esta inteligencia) on this understanding
mediados: (a mediados de) in the middle of
obra: work; (es obra de) a matter of
pequeño: small; (en pequeño) on a small scale
pie: footing; (en pie) on a footing of
presente: present; (tener presente) to bear in mind
q: (Q. B. S. M.) who kisses your hand
tocar: to touch; (tocar los extremos) to go to extremes
transar: to settle, to come to terms
puño: (de su puño) in his own hand
